output_artifact.parent_requirement: Live Pre-Lock Recommendation Workflow with Risk-Audited Artifact

acceptance_criteria: scripts/run_live_round.py accepts --season, --budget, --current-year, --model-id, --footystats-mode, --fixture-mode, --matchup-context-mode, and --capture-policy; it rejects a user-supplied --target-round input.

A successful run writes recommended_squad.csv, candidate_predictions.csv, recommendation_summary.json, and run_metadata.json into a unique directory under data/08_reporting/recommendations/{season}/round-{target_round}/live/runs/run_started_at=..., with UTC ISO-8601 timestamps in all metadata.

recommendation_summary.json records predicted_points_with_captain, budget_used, budget, captain_id, and captain_policy fields (captain_policy_ev, captain_policy_safe, captain_policy_upside), and budget_used ≤ budget.

recommended_squad.csv includes exactly one row with is_captain=true (that row is not a tecnico) and contains captain_policy columns (captain_policy_ev, captain_policy_safe, captain_policy_upside) for each player.
Neither recommended_squad.csv nor candidate_predictions.csv contains finalized target-round actual points or scout outcome columns.
If the operator-provided budget is missing, the command fails with a clear error message before generating any squad.

Run metadata links to the market capture identity, model profile, feature pack, fixture mode, matchup mode, budget, selected squad artifact, and output directory; the run directory is unique and does not overwrite previous live recommendations.
When live mode cannot establish a pre-lock evidence boundary (market unavailable or closed), the workflow fails before squad generation.
user_stories.statement: As an operator, I want to generate a live squad recommendation by running a single command with my budget and model configuration before market lock, so that I can receive a risk-audited recommendation artifact for review.
